areas.how: Content is Markdown documentation, not a CMS: skills/<skill>/SKILL.md is the source of truth and carries YAML front matter (name, description, compatibility, metadata); README.md and install.md are the public prose. English only, no build step, no front matter in the root docs.

No website and no page builder. The docs are distributed by installers: npx skills add DeliveristsIO/quento-skills copies skills/<skill>/SKILL.md into the user's agent, and the Claude Code plugin (.claude-plugin/plugin.json and marketplace.json) also registers the Quento MCP server declared in mcp.json.

No image files in the repository. The only picture on screen is the demo thumbnail embedded in README.md as an external YouTube URL (https://img.youtube.com/vi/KNJRGLmh1oc/maxresdefault.jpg), so there is no image directory and no image build step.
